reviews.title: Beware!!!! Takes money from your Apple Cash and you can’t unsubscribe!!!
reviews.text:
My 14 year old downloaded this app, and given the nature of the app, I mistakenly assumed was harmless.  The app started taking $6.99 out of her Apple Cash account every few days, and unfortunately it was a couple months before she was aware.  This is money she made from babysitting, so hits especially hard.

She deleted the app, but there was no subscription to unsubscribe from! It kept trying to take $ even when we kept her account at 0.  We called Apple Cash they paused her Cash account, but as of this post they are not helping us recover the money.  We will keep trying.

I hope this review helps others protect themselves.

So I’ve heard about haven, mainly from YouTube videos, I know that is described as some sort of way to grow your faith in Christ by asking biblical related questions, but I’m honestly skeptical, for 2 reasons.

1: it is a weekly subscription, not a 1 time purchase, £7 a week, meaning I have to spend £364 a year just to use this app, this app should be for a spiritual growth.
Not financial gain. And sure some bibles can be expensive but at least it’s a 1-time purchase

2: it is AI driven,
The entire app is based on artificial intelligence, And as a christian I do not trust ai when it comes to religion. The answers may not always be correct.

So I personally wouldn’t recommend this app.

I find it hard to wrap my head around why some people would charge others who are wanting to grow closer to God, I personally think that’s kind of evil. I’m sure it’s a great app if you are willing to pay. If you can’t pay, please don’t waste your time on this app, I recommend The Bible app by YouVersion, which is completely free and has amazing resources, just no AI feature.

reviews.title: Shameless Money Grab
reviews.text:
I try to stay open-minded towards apps and devs due to the costs associated with simply doing business. However, an unsaved, homeless person who is seeking God, can not afford food, meds, etc does NOT need to answer your “caring” questions just to be hit with a $6.99 A WEEK subscription fee (after the generous 3-day free trial, that is.) 
This app is a shameless money grab attempting to make as MUCH as possible by severely overcharging the desperate, the hopeless, the lost, the needy in our communities! They come to you asking for a cup of water in His Name, and you are trying to rent them not only the cup, but also lease them the water as well! Haven backwards is Nevah, and Nevah is how often Jesus would support your overturned money-changing table excuse for an app. Please, please, please prove me wrong! Change your approach and I will GLADLY change my mind and my review. 
-A Pastor of The Faith
